phrases.english_text: I used to be there cause the girl worked there. I would go home about 10 o’clock, she would drop me off and they said she started running around. And when she takes Granny with her, “Let’s take her to Vian.” “Where are we going?” I said. “To somebody named Smith,” she said. “Why do you do what he says to do?” “Let’s just go over there,” she said. So we went, and this old man was asking me. I said I didn’t believe in this stuff. I had never heard of it being medicine, I had never used tobacco and I never smoked. But this old man was asking questions and he was saying the same thing.

phrases.english_text: Mike’s aunt got there and would relieve me.
